description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams, used to encapsulate search filter parameters for internationalization language entities within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for filtering enabled and added languages.

classes.name: I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters when querying language data, includes options to filter by enabled and added status, with default sorting by language name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with a default sort field 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEnabledOnly
methods.description: Returns the filter for enabled languages, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEnabledOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter for including only enabled languages.

methods.name: getAddedOnly
methods.description: Returns the filter for whether only added languages are included, or null if not set.

methods.name: setAddedOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only added languages.
